market_expectation.working_distribution_limitation: Research approximation using the reported 92.5% +25bp probability and assigning the residual to hold. Not a substitute for a full real-time FedWatch probability tree.

pre_event_market_evidence.fact: Dollar held near multi-week highs as markets expected a Fed hike and possible further tightening.
Markets were pricing roughly a 93% chance of a hike; US 10-year yield had recently moved above 5% before the decision.
Nasdaq volatility compression was unusually low before the event, leaving the FOMC as a potential catalyst without determining breakout direction.

challenger_interpretation.important_distinction: Do not double-count the expected target action as a fresh shock. The high level of yields/oil/inflation remains a separate macro-regime input, while path, statement, press conference and target surprise remain live event risks.
not_claimed: The post-FOMC equity direction is known before the release
Pre-event price moves prove information leakage
A 92.5% target probability means path risk is 92.5% resolved
